profile_exclusions.reason: The Gyrocopter is a vehicle the warband buys, not a fighter: its profile line carries only Toughness and Wounds, and its Movement, crew, transport capacity and malfunction rules belong to the vehicle subsystem. It has no individual close-combat fighter line for the duel runtime.
The River Boat is a watercraft the warband fields, not a fighter: every characteristic of its profile line is blank and its rule is transport. It has no fighter characteristics to compile.
